actual.descripcion: Musicians who rarely appear on television perform, featuring genres from folk music to new music.

siguiente.descripcion: A delinquent youth named Ishihei is denied a library card due to an unreturned book from ten years ago; after understanding the importance of books purchased with taxes, he buys and returns the book and begins working part-time at the library.
